title: A multimodal vision foundation model for clinical dermatology
cohort: HAM10000 paper benchmark; authors’ stated split differs from released CSV
f1_definition: Weighted F1; macro F1 and F0.5 not provided in cited table
finding: A dermatology foundation encoder with a trained linear probe supports strong transfer.
caveat: Published benchmark is not our official 1,512-image test. Our local authors-recipe run is a separate reproduction, not this published number.
per_class_note: The cited HAM table reports aggregate metrics; seven-class F1 values are not transcribed.

title: Transfer learning using a multi-scale and multi-network ensemble for skin lesion classification
cohort: Official ISIC 2018 Task 3 challenge test, seven classes
f1_definition: F1 and F0.5 not reported in the cited primary-source abstract
finding: Combining cropped images at six scales and three CNN architectures improved classification over single-network or single-scale alternatives.
caveat: 86.2% is balanced accuracy, not ordinary accuracy or F1. Same challenge cohort name does not imply matched training data or preprocessing.
per_class_note: The cited abstract does not provide seven-class scores.

title: Multiscale Feature Fusion for Skin Lesion Classification
f1_definition: Aggregate F1 in Table 4; averaging is not sufficiently specified to label it macro or weighted
finding: DenseNet-121 and an altered VGG-16 fuse multi-scale features; augmentation is applied to training classes.
caveat: Different internal images and preprocessing from our splits. The paper’s macroaverage terminology is ambiguous; 95% is not relabelled as macro F1.
per_class_note: Aggregate tables are used; no numerical class-F1 table is available in the cited sections.

title: Combining State-of-the-Art Pre-Trained Deep Learning Models: A Noble Approach for Skin Cancer Detection Using Max Voting Ensemble
result_source: HAM10000 Table 11, PDF page 27; Diagnostics 14, 89, DOI 10.3390/diagnostics14010089
cohort: Authors’ oversampled HAM10000 evaluation; Table 11 support n=11,734
f1_definition: Macro and weighted F1 reported rounded to 0.95 in Table 11
finding: A max-voting ensemble combines ten pretrained CNN architectures.
caveat: Section 4.1 describes oversampling then an 80/10/10 split. The nearly balanced Table 11 support exceeds original HAM10000 size; these are not comparable natural-prevalence held-out images. Values are published claims, not independently reproduced.
per_class_note: Rounded published Table 11 values, on the authors’ oversampled cohort. F0.5 not reported; not inferred from rounded inputs.

title: Enhanced skin cancer diagnosis using optimized CNN architecture and checkpoints for automated dermatological lesion classification
result_source: Narrative Results (97.858%); publisher Figure 8 (76% accuracy, 48% macro F1), shown separately
cohort: Authors’ internal HAM10000 evaluation; split not matched to ours
f1_definition: Narrative claim and Figure 8 conflict; separate result rows are shown.
finding: The CNN uses augmentation, regularization, early stopping and model checkpoints.
caveat: Internal discrepancy: narrative reports 97.858% accuracy, but Figure 8 shows 76% accuracy, 48% macro F1 and 76% weighted F1. The cohort relationship is not explained; results are not merged or treated as independently verified.
per_class_note: Figure 8 values visually transcribed from the publisher on 2026-10-28. They belong to the figure, not to the 97.858% narrative claim. F0.5 and support are not reported.
per_class_cohort: Figure 8 classification report; cohort not specified; inconsistent with narrative accuracy claim
